prompt: I’m going on a weekend trip to Germany and have limited space in my luggage. I’m choosing between taking with me either an umbrella or a waterproof jacket. Which one will me more useful to take with me?
response: In Germany, you're more likely to encounter dry weather, so an umbrella might be overkill. A waterproof jacket is a safer choice as it can be used in various conditions, and you can always dry it out when you return. An umbrella takes up more space and might not be as practical.
